featured_reviews.name: Asavari Chendvankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Do not go to this restaurant by seeing the ambience.
I would rather give minus stars for this resturant but that option is not available.

I went there on 7th June to celebrate my husband's birthday. I was amazed by the ambience of the place.
We ordered
1. Cheese pakoda
2. Masala pineapple mocktail
3. Summer delight mocktail
I have never ever eaten such a pathetic cheese pakoda. Literally it was a cheese cube dipped in batter and fried in oil.
Masala pineapple tasted like masala water.
Summer delight was also not up to the mark.

After tasting this we skipped our plan for having lunch over there and went to another place.
They take forever to bring ur order and after such a long wait they serve such a pathetic thing and on top of that the cost is so high.

We somehow drank our cocktails and tried finishing the cheese pakoda but couldn't and went home.  After few minutes our stomach was upset and we very well knew it was because of the food which we had.

It totally ruined our holiday and celebration too.

featured_reviews.name: Bikas Nath
featured_reviews.review_text: The food was good. Service was very slow. The farm environment was good, but if you are visiting at night, be ready to be welcomed by insects and mosquitoes. They provide repellent though to scare the insects away. Ambience is good though. They have a long list of items in their menu with chicken and seafoods. Crabs are also available. In all, I had a good time with my family there.

featured_reviews.name: Yogesh Karnik
featured_reviews.review_text:
I always like open places for dining rather than indoor or closed settlement.
One of the nature surrounding place...  Far view is the one of the specious space for familys & Friends. Good food and service. Nonveg crab lollypop were new for us.  We Enjoyed our lit evening...
Staff are very cooperative. For big group & birthday celebration this can be one option for suy.

Note. If you are going to visit this place after 9 pm there is hardly any public transport even rarely you get any online ride. So you must arrange your transpy.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hey Yogesh,

Thank you for taking the time to share your wonderful experience at Farm View Family Restaurant & Bar! We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed our spacious outdoor seating area, which offers a serene and natural ambiance perfect for families and friends to gather.

We're thrilled to know that you appreciated our good food and service, and that our non-veg crab lollypop was a new and enjoyable experience for you. We're glad that you had a great time during your evening visit.

We're also grateful for your feedback regarding our staff's cooperation, and we're happy to hear that they were helpful in making your birthday celebration a success.

Regarding your suggestion about transportation, we appreciate your honesty and will definitely take it into consideration. We understand that public transportation options might be limited after 9 pm, and we'll look into providing alternative arrangements for our guests.

Once again, thank you for your kind words and for choosing Farm View Family Restaurant & Bar. We hope to welcome you back soon and provide you with an even more enjoyable experience.

Warm Regards,
Team Farm View Family Restaurant & Bar.

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Sonawane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Disappointing Experience

I'm still frowning thinking about my Sunday lunch. A family gathering of 8 turned sour due to subpar food and service. The chicken and curries had a weird smell, chapati was chewy, naan was overly salty, and the chicken was undercooked with skin still on 😒.

The restaurant was half empty, but service was painfully slow. We had to repeatedly ask for new plates, water, glasses, and even salt. The quality was below par, yet prices matched Mumbai restaurants.

Unfortunately, this was the worst food I've ever had, and I'd strongly advise against wasting your money here. Not worth it!
